content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing an issue with a [product_name] ([article_no]). The device has been working fine, but now I'm seeing a "Diagnostics Micro SD card detached" message and it's gone into STOP mode. I couldn't find any documentation on this error. Which SD card is being referenced? I suspect it's not the front slot because it's used only for program uploads and is currently empty. Is there an internal SD card? Any advice would be appreciated. Thanks. P.S. I have attached two images showing the error and STOP status.

Hi @user_name, It's unusual since you said there's no SD card in use. Still, try opening the slot to see if one is present. My own [product_name] devices and operator panel don't have SD cards, but show a similar message in orange, indicating no error. My suggestion is to open the housing and check for any issues with bent pins.
There is no internal SD card. Consider submitting a support request.

"SD card" refers to the Micro SD card, not the internal EEPROM. If your application doesn't require a card, simply remove it. Otherwise, check detection through: Diagnostics > Hardware > SD Card. If the status reads: Diagnostic Micro SD Card OK, then it's recognized. If not, try a different card.

The device has always worked fine without a card since I upload my program via Ethernet, and it doesn't require an SD card. I'll need to check if someone inserted a card unexpectedly. Is it possible that the device entered STOP mode because a card was inserted, causing it to check for a program on the SD card instead of the EEPROM, which might be empty or incorrectly formatted?

That scenario is definitely possible. If someone wasn't careful, they may have bent the pins in the card mechanism, so these should be inspected, even if the SD card isn't present. Regards, [user_name] (translated by Google)

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter the "Diagnostics Micro SD card detached" error on [product_name], leading to STOP mode even when no SD card is in use. There's ambiguity about which storage device the error pertains to and a lack of documentation regarding this message. Users are unclear about how the device behaves when an SD card is inserted or removed unexpectedly, highlighting areas for improved error clarity and device feedback.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect more transparent error messages from the product, better documentation covering error scenarios, and consistent device operation regardless of SD card presence when it isn't required for their application.
